meta.title: Restart
meta.description: It's like this. Everything restarts anew.

units.rawText: The Oasis, near Weather Balloon 1
units.displayText: The Oasis, near Weather Balloon 1

spans.text: The Oasis, near Weather Balloon 1

units.rawText: Simo stands at the edges of the Oasis, staring off into the distance.
units.displayText: Simo stands at the edges of the Oasis, staring off into the distance.

spans.text: Simo stands at the edges of the Oasis, staring off into the distance.

units.rawText: Squeak!
units.displayText: Squeak!

spans.text: Squeak!

units.rawText: Ah... Sako, good afternoon.
units.displayText: Ah... Sako, good afternoon.

spans.text: Ah... Sako, good afternoon.

units.rawText: The ermine sniffs Simo's fingers as if confirming something before rubbing his cheek intimately.
units.displayText: The ermine sniffs Simo's fingers as if confirming something before rubbing his cheek intimately.

spans.text: The ermine sniffs Simo's fingers as if confirming something before rubbing his cheek intimately.

units.rawText: You always manage to come back to me. Just how exactly do you manage it?
units.displayText: You always manage to come back to me. Just how exactly do you manage it?

spans.text: You always manage to come back to me. Just how exactly do you manage it?

units.rawText: Are you an ermine specifically trained for reconaissance?
units.displayText: Are you an ermine specifically trained for reconaissance?

spans.text: Are you an ermine specifically trained for reconaissance?

units.rawText: Squeak?
units.displayText: Squeak?

spans.text: Squeak?

units.rawText: ...I thought you were an agent with the appearance of an animal, but you really don't have language recognition in you.
units.displayText: ...I thought you were an agent with the appearance of an animal, but you really don't have language recognition in you.

spans.text: ...I thought you were an agent with the appearance of an animal, but you really don't have language recognition in you.

units.rawText: Hm... Persicaria did tell me how to play with an ermine...
units.displayText: Hm... Persicaria did tell me how to play with an ermine...

spans.text: Hm... Persicaria did tell me how to play with an ermine...

units.rawText: Simo tries to grab Sako beneath the forelimbs, swinging it about.
units.displayText: Simo tries to grab Sako beneath the forelimbs, swinging it about.

spans.text: Simo tries to grab Sako beneath the forelimbs, swinging it about.

units.rawText: Sako hangs relaxedly in Simo's hands, sway back and forth like an ice pop.
units.displayText: Sako hangs relaxedly in Simo's hands, sway back and forth like an ice pop.

spans.text: Sako hangs relaxedly in Simo's hands, sway back and forth like an ice pop.

units.rawText: Persicaria said this would calm you down right down. She wasn't lying.
units.displayText: Persicaria said this would calm you down right down. She wasn't lying.

spans.text: Persicaria said this would calm you down right down. She wasn't lying.

units.rawText: ...But we just met each other. How can you trust me so?
units.displayText: ...But we just met each other. How can you trust me so?

spans.text: ...But we just met each other. How can you trust me so?

units.rawText: Clearly, Sako understands not the mutterings of its master.
units.displayText: Clearly, Sako understands not the mutterings of its master.

spans.text: Clearly, Sako understands not the mutterings of its master.

units.rawText: Simo shakes his head with a mixture of amusement and powerlessness.
units.displayText: Simo shakes his head with a mixture of amusement and powerlessness.

spans.text: Simo shakes his head with a mixture of amusement and powerlessness.

units.rawText: My commander... Professor hasn't given me any commands for the past three days.
units.displayText: My commander... Professor hasn't given me any commands for the past three days.

spans.text: My commander... Professor hasn't given me any commands for the past three days.

units.rawText: I suppose I can always go training before any order's given.
units.displayText: I suppose I can always go training before any order's given.

spans.text: I suppose I can always go training before any order's given.

units.rawText: Wait! Right this second, don't move!
units.displayText: Wait! Right this second, don't move!

spans.text: Wait! Right this second, don't move!

units.rawText: An obviously modulated voice emitted from behind the weather balloon.
units.displayText: An obviously modulated voice emitted from behind the weather balloon.

spans.text: An obviously modulated voice emitted from behind the weather balloon.

units.rawText: As if it was instinct, Simo trained his crossbow at the weather balloon. Sako looks at the balloon, then at Simo, befuddled.
units.displayText: As if it was instinct, Simo trained his crossbow at the weather balloon. Sako looks at the balloon, then at Simo, befuddled.

spans.text: As if it was instinct, Simo trained his crossbow at the weather balloon. Sako looks at the balloon, then at Simo, befuddled.

units.rawText: Line of fire: clear, firing system: normal!
units.displayText: Line of fire: clear, firing system: normal!

spans.text: Line of fire: clear, firing system: normal!

units.rawText: Code: "This time I'll definitely..." Mmmmmmm...
units.displayText: Code: "This time I'll definitely..." Mmmmmmm...

spans.text: Code: "This time I'll definitely..." Mmmmmmm...

units.rawText: No alarms... no unusual hostile signals, either.
units.displayText: No alarms... no unusual hostile signals, either.

spans.text: No alarms... no unusual hostile signals, either.

units.rawText: ...You there, behind the balloon. Are you from the Oasis, or here to make a practical joke?
units.displayText: ...You there, behind the balloon. Are you from the Oasis, or here to make a practical joke?

spans.text: ...You there, behind the balloon. Are you from the Oasis, or here to make a practical joke?

units.rawText: Don't cover my mouth like that, An... Mmmm...
units.displayText: Don't cover my mouth like that, An... Mmmm...

spans.text: Don't cover my mouth like that, An... Mmmm...

units.rawText: ...I'm leaving.
units.displayText: ...I'm leaving.

spans.text: ...I'm leaving.

units.rawText: ...Sigh. Drag me all the way over here out of the blue, and then want me to do the talking...
units.displayText: ...Sigh. Drag me all the way over here out of the blue, and then want me to do the talking...

spans.text: ...Sigh. Drag me all the way over here out of the blue, and then want me to do the talking...

units.rawText: Simo, hold on for a sec.
units.displayText: Simo, hold on for a sec.

spans.text: Simo, hold on for a sec.

units.rawText: We're your friends. You'll get to know our identities later.
units.displayText: We're your friends. You'll get to know our identities later.

spans.text: We're your friends. You'll get to know our identities later.

units.rawText: But due to a certain someone's request, we can't show ourselves yet.
units.displayText: But due to a certain someone's request, we can't show ourselves yet.

spans.text: But due to a certain someone's request, we can't show ourselves yet.

units.rawText: Mmmmm... Pfft!
units.displayText: Mmmmm... Pfft!

spans.text: Mmmmm... Pfft!

units.rawText: Our identity is irrelevant for this conversation, for the truest of heroes leave no signature with their acts...
units.displayText: Our identity is irrelevant for this conversation, for the truest of heroes leave no signature with their acts...

spans.text: Our identity is irrelevant for this conversation, for the truest of heroes leave no signature with their acts...

units.rawText: Alright alright I get it, I won't go off-topic again, cut it out!
units.displayText: Alright alright I get it, I won't go off-topic again, cut it out!

spans.text: Alright alright I get it, I won't go off-topic again, cut it out!

units.rawText: There's no intruder alarm going off in the Oasis' security system, and I suppose if an enemy was to use such methods, they'd be discovered by the Professor.
units.displayText: There's no intruder alarm going off in the Oasis' security system, and I suppose if an enemy was to use such methods, they'd be discovered by the Professor.

spans.text: There's no intruder alarm going off in the Oasis' security system, and I suppose if an enemy was to use such methods, they'd be discovered by the Professor.

units.rawText: Then, what is it that you want to say, "friends"?
units.displayText: Then, what is it that you want to say, "friends"?

spans.text: Then, what is it that you want to say, "friends"?

units.rawText: It's been three days since you came to the Oasis, and I'm sure you've already sorted out your neural data.
units.displayText: It's been three days since you came to the Oasis, and I'm sure you've already sorted out your neural data.

spans.text: It's been three days since you came to the Oasis, and I'm sure you've already sorted out your neural data.

units.rawText: Have you ever... had nightmares, or something akin to that?
units.displayText: Have you ever... had nightmares, or something akin to that?

spans.text: Have you ever... had nightmares, or something akin to that?

units.rawText: ...Would those impair my ability to execute orders given to me?
units.displayText: ...Would those impair my ability to execute orders given to me?

spans.text: ...Would those impair my ability to execute orders given to me?

units.rawText: It would appear so.
units.displayText: It would appear so.

spans.text: It would appear so.

units.rawText: Don't worry, this is perfectly normal.
units.displayText: Don't worry, this is perfectly normal.

spans.text: Don't worry, this is perfectly normal.

units.rawText: ...Is it, now?
units.displayText: ...Is it, now?

spans.text: ...Is it, now?

units.rawText: It is, for you.
units.displayText: It is, for you.

spans.text: It is, for you.

units.rawText: You should have already noticed. This is not the first time that you've been awakened.
units.displayText: You should have already noticed. This is not the first time that you've been awakened.

spans.text: You should have already noticed. This is not the first time that you've been awakened.

units.rawText: <size=24>Wait. Isn't approaching it this a bit too...</size>
units.displayText: Wait. Isn't approaching it this a bit too...

spans.text: Wait. Isn't approaching it this a bit too...

units.rawText: <size=24>It's alright. He'll know sooner or later anyway.</size>
units.displayText: It's alright. He'll know sooner or later anyway.

spans.text: It's alright. He'll know sooner or later anyway.

units.rawText: Yeah... those "nightmares" should be memory fragments left behind from before.
units.displayText: Yeah... those "nightmares" should be memory fragments left behind from before.

spans.text: Yeah... those "nightmares" should be memory fragments left behind from before.

units.rawText: Your assumptions are correct. Those are memory fragments left in your neural system.
units.displayText: Your assumptions are correct. Those are memory fragments left in your neural system.

spans.text: Your assumptions are correct. Those are memory fragments left in your neural system.

units.rawText: It's normal to come into contact with them when you comb through your data, and that is why I'm here.
units.displayText: It's normal to come into contact with them when you comb through your data, and that is why I'm here.

spans.text: It's normal to come into contact with them when you comb through your data, and that is why I'm here.

units.rawText: ...Do you intend to clean them out?
units.displayText: ...Do you intend to clean them out?

spans.text: ...Do you intend to clean them out?

units.rawText: Don't you want to be free of those fragments?
units.displayText: Don't you want to be free of those fragments?

spans.text: Don't you want to be free of those fragments?

units.rawText: For those fragments to be left behind—isn't that proof that such a past existed for me?
units.displayText: For those fragments to be left behind—isn't that proof that such a past existed for me?

spans.text: For those fragments to be left behind—isn't that proof that such a past existed for me?

units.rawText: ...if they were to be deleted, would my past fade away as well?
units.displayText: ...if they were to be deleted, would my past fade away as well?

spans.text: ...if they were to be deleted, would my past fade away as well?

units.rawText: That can't possibly happen. The past is unchangeable.
units.displayText: That can't possibly happen. The past is unchangeable.

spans.text: That can't possibly happen. The past is unchangeable.

units.rawText: No matter how one alters or modifies data, there will always be some information left. When one puts their mind to it, they'll always be able to relive those circumstances.
units.displayText: No matter how one alters or modifies data, there will always be some information left. When one puts their mind to it, they'll always be able to relive those circumstances.

spans.text: No matter how one alters or modifies data, there will always be some information left. When one puts their mind to it, they'll always be able to relive those circumstances.

units.rawText: Then it's meaningless to delete them thoroughly.
units.displayText: Then it's meaningless to delete them thoroughly.

spans.text: Then it's meaningless to delete them thoroughly.

units.rawText: No matter how the past is denied, it persists, and makes me manifest here.
units.displayText: No matter how the past is denied, it persists, and makes me manifest here.

spans.text: No matter how the past is denied, it persists, and makes me manifest here.

units.rawText: <size=24>But everyone in the Oasis can pretend that it doesn't exist...</size>
units.displayText: But everyone in the Oasis can pretend that it doesn't exist...

spans.text: But everyone in the Oasis can pretend that it doesn't exist...

units.rawText: <size=24>We'll have to deal with reality sooner or later. His concerns are not unfounded.</size>
units.displayText: We'll have to deal with reality sooner or later. His concerns are not unfounded.

spans.text: We'll have to deal with reality sooner or later. His concerns are not unfounded.

units.rawText: Hey... my auditory modules are really well-developed, and I can still hear really small sounds.
units.displayText: Hey... my auditory modules are really well-developed, and I can still hear really small sounds.

spans.text: Hey... my auditory modules are really well-developed, and I can still hear really small sounds.

units.rawText: ...You didn't screen that for me?
units.displayText: ...You didn't screen that for me?

spans.text: ...You didn't screen that for me?

units.rawText: Because there's no need. We're still straining for operands here in the Oasis, and I have no intent of wasting such a valuable resource.
units.displayText: Because there's no need. We're still straining for operands here in the Oasis, and I have no intent of wasting such a valuable resource.

spans.text: Because there's no need. We're still straining for operands here in the Oasis, and I have no intent of wasting such a valuable resource.

units.rawText: So everything I complained about just then, he heard?
units.displayText: So everything I complained about just then, he heard?

spans.text: So everything I complained about just then, he heard?

units.rawText: Be quiet. Listen to him.
units.displayText: Be quiet. Listen to him.

spans.text: Be quiet. Listen to him.

units.rawText: You claim to be my friends, then...
units.displayText: You claim to be my friends, then...

spans.text: You claim to be my friends, then...

units.rawText: Can you tell me what really happened in the past?
units.displayText: Can you tell me what really happened in the past?

spans.text: Can you tell me what really happened in the past?

units.rawText: Are you sure?
units.displayText: Are you sure?

spans.text: Are you sure?

units.rawText: Simo falls silent.
units.displayText: Simo falls silent.

spans.text: Simo falls silent.

units.rawText: Sako jumps off from his palm, scampering about behind the weather balloon.
units.displayText: Sako jumps off from his palm, scampering about behind the weather balloon.

spans.text: Sako jumps off from his palm, scampering about behind the weather balloon.

units.rawText: Don't make decisions when your mind is still clouded, Simo.
units.displayText: Don't make decisions when your mind is still clouded, Simo.

spans.text: Don't make decisions when your mind is still clouded, Simo.

units.rawText: ...I am Gaul, but Professor and Persicaria tell me that my name is Simo.
units.displayText: ...I am Gaul, but Professor and Persicaria tell me that my name is Simo.

spans.text: ...I am Gaul, but Professor and Persicaria tell me that my name is Simo.

units.rawText: This name must've been one that my past self took on, and yet I know nothing of what stories it pays tribute to.
units.displayText: This name must've been one that my past self took on, and yet I know nothing of what stories it pays tribute to.

spans.text: This name must've been one that my past self took on, and yet I know nothing of what stories it pays tribute to.

units.rawText: I don't understand why Sako is so intimate to me, either.
units.displayText: I don't understand why Sako is so intimate to me, either.

spans.text: I don't understand why Sako is so intimate to me, either.

units.rawText: If I can neither deny the past nor explore it... Who exactly am I?
units.displayText: If I can neither deny the past nor explore it... Who exactly am I?

spans.text: If I can neither deny the past nor explore it... Who exactly am I?

units.rawText: Just like the fragments left behind after formatting, the past will always hold sway over the current you.
units.displayText: Just like the fragments left behind after formatting, the past will always hold sway over the current you.

spans.text: Just like the fragments left behind after formatting, the past will always hold sway over the current you.

units.rawText: Those nightmares are indeed parts of your past, and they are things we cannot deny.
units.displayText: Those nightmares are indeed parts of your past, and they are things we cannot deny.

spans.text: Those nightmares are indeed parts of your past, and they are things we cannot deny.

units.rawText: ...I thought so as well. These... are just things that I cannot escape.
units.displayText: ...I thought so as well. These... are just things that I cannot escape.

spans.text: ...I thought so as well. These... are just things that I cannot escape.

units.rawText: But the past left you more than that. You still have the name "Simo", Sako, and us.
units.displayText: But the past left you more than that. You still have the name "Simo", Sako, and us.

spans.text: But the past left you more than that. You still have the name "Simo", Sako, and us.

units.rawText: The past persists, but it cannot do any more.
units.displayText: The past persists, but it cannot do any more.

spans.text: The past persists, but it cannot do any more.

units.rawText: This tone... Is that you, Professor?
units.displayText: This tone... Is that you, Professor?

spans.text: This tone... Is that you, Professor?

units.rawText: Our identity matters not.
units.displayText: Our identity matters not.

spans.text: Our identity matters not.

units.rawText: Yes. If that's the case, then the past is something that must be retrieved.
units.displayText: Yes. If that's the case, then the past is something that must be retrieved.

spans.text: Yes. If that's the case, then the past is something that must be retrieved.

units.rawText: Not so.
units.displayText: Not so.

spans.text: Not so.

units.rawText: Now, you have the right to choose. If you choose to look towards the future, we'll pay you no less respect.
units.displayText: Now, you have the right to choose. If you choose to look towards the future, we'll pay you no less respect.

spans.text: Now, you have the right to choose. If you choose to look towards the future, we'll pay you no less respect.

units.rawText: Only looking at the future... and yet the past exists all the same.
units.displayText: Only looking at the future... and yet the past exists all the same.

spans.text: Only looking at the future... and yet the past exists all the same.

units.rawText: So long as we're here, no past is going to catch up with you.
units.displayText: So long as we're here, no past is going to catch up with you.

spans.text: So long as we're here, no past is going to catch up with you.

units.rawText: You're not a protagonist, why do you get to drop cool lines like that?
units.displayText: You're not a protagonist, why do you get to drop cool lines like that?

spans.text: You're not a protagonist, why do you get to drop cool lines like that?

units.rawText: Identity is not of importance here. That's what you said.
units.displayText: Identity is not of importance here. That's what you said.

spans.text: Identity is not of importance here. That's what you said.

units.rawText: ...Please allow me to think on this.
units.displayText: ...Please allow me to think on this.

spans.text: ...Please allow me to think on this.

units.rawText: We await your decision.
units.displayText: We await your decision.

spans.text: We await your decision.

units.rawText: ...So, can I go now?
units.displayText: ...So, can I go now?

spans.text: ...So, can I go now?

units.rawText: Simo received no answer.
units.displayText: Simo received no answer.

spans.text: Simo received no answer.

units.rawText: After a brief wait, Simo walks towards the back side of the weather balloon.
units.displayText: After a brief wait, Simo walks towards the back side of the weather balloon.

spans.text: After a brief wait, Simo walks towards the back side of the weather balloon.

units.rawText: Not a soul was to be found here.
units.displayText: Not a soul was to be found here.

spans.text: Not a soul was to be found here.

units.rawText: Sako, coiled around a piece of broadcasting equipment, looks at Simo confusedly.
units.displayText: Sako, coiled around a piece of broadcasting equipment, looks at Simo confusedly.

spans.text: Sako, coiled around a piece of broadcasting equipment, looks at Simo confusedly.

units.rawText: One day later, Headquarters
units.displayText: One day later, Headquarters

spans.text: One day later, Headquarters

units.rawText: Professor, are you there?
units.displayText: Professor, are you there?

spans.text: Professor, are you there?

units.rawText: About the future and past, I think I've reached a decision.
units.displayText: About the future and past, I think I've reached a decision.

spans.text: About the future and past, I think I've reached a decision.

units.rawText: Before the Professor, he takes a deep breath, his eyes adamant, steely resolve taking hold.
units.displayText: Before the Professor, he takes a deep breath, his eyes adamant, steely resolve taking hold.

spans.text: Before the Professor, he takes a deep breath, his eyes adamant, steely resolve taking hold.

units.rawText: My choice is—
units.displayText: My choice is—

spans.text: My choice is—
